content: WebView2 supports browser extensions only as unpacked local folders via CoreWebView2Profile.AddBrowserExtensionAsync (ICoreWebView2Profile7), with AreBrowserExtensionsEnabled=true. No Chrome Web Store installation, no packaged CRX; extension UI entry points (icons, badges, popups) are missing because WebView2 has no browser UI. PlayReady is supported; Widevine is an open feature request, not supported.
